description: The bar chart illustrates the number of sentences (in thousands) across several text categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled “Administrative,” “Religion,” “Non-fiction,” “Fiction,” “Law,” “News,” “Science,” and “Blogs,” shown left to right with diagonally rotated tick labels; the axis label is “Categories.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Sentences (K),” using a linear scale with tick marks at approximately 0, 200, 400, 600, and 800 (range extending to just above 900). Each category is represented by a single vertical bar: Administrative is a salmon/pink bar labeled 525; Religion shows a short salmon/pink bar around 50 and an additional light-gray bar around 150 (two bars at the same category position); Non-fiction is salmon/pink labeled 190; Fiction is salmon/pink labeled 35; Law is salmon/pink labeled 23; News is salmon/pink labeled 902; Science is salmon/pink labeled 110; and Blogs is salmon/pink labeled 2. Numeric value annotations in dark blue appear above most salmon/pink bars, and the categories are not displayed in an explicitly sorted order.
